conflicts.tension: Higher contrast improves attention but excessive chroma fragments the composition.
conflicts.analysis: Higher contrast improves attention but excessive chroma fragments the composition.
conflicts.resolution: Use tonal/size/spacing differentiation first, a restrained accent second; never lower contrast below WCAG.
conflicts.override: Accessibility wins for applicable contrast requirements.

conflicts.tension: A single hero may hide two equally critical actions.
conflicts.analysis: A single hero may hide two equally critical actions.
conflicts.resolution: Derive priority from the actual user task; maintain discoverability and neutrality for high-stakes choices.

conflicts.tension: Airy design harms dense comparison tasks.
conflicts.analysis: Airy design harms dense comparison tasks.
conflicts.resolution: Increase group clarity without removing task-relevant visible context.
conflicts.override: Judge by scan performance, not subjective spaciousness.

conflicts.tension: Dynamic asymmetry may feel unstable on narrow screens.
conflicts.analysis: Dynamic asymmetry may feel unstable on narrow screens.
conflicts.resolution: Rebalance actual visual weight at each breakpoint.

conflicts.tension: Analogous and brand palette pairs can fail text/control contrast.
conflicts.analysis: Analogous and brand palette pairs can fail text/control contrast.
conflicts.resolution: Choose accessible foreground/background role pairings and test all interaction states.
conflicts.override: WCAG is normative for compliance target.

conflicts.tension: Identical repeated cards hide the featured item.
conflicts.analysis: Identical repeated cards hide the featured item.
conflicts.resolution: Keep predictable component roles but vary real priority within the pattern.

conflicts.tension: Overuniform styling hides errors and destructive actions.
conflicts.analysis: Overuniform styling hides errors and destructive actions.
conflicts.resolution: Consistent structure plus unmistakably differentiated semantic state.
conflicts.override: Color is not sole state indicator.

conflicts.tension: Visual scanning path differs from keyboard/AT order.
conflicts.analysis: Visual scanning path differs from keyboard/AT order.
conflicts.resolution: Build source/DOM order first and treat visual positioning as an enhancement.

conflicts.tension: Rigid elegant ratio clips on mobile or localization.
conflicts.analysis: Rigid elegant ratio clips on mobile or localization.
conflicts.resolution: Use fluid bounds and content-driven breakpoints.
conflicts.override: Function and reflow outrank geometric purity.

conflicts.tension: Every campaign wants a unique visual language.
conflicts.analysis: Every campaign wants a unique visual language.
conflicts.resolution: Constrain creative variance to a clearly defined axis.

conflicts.tension: Text atop striking image becomes unreadable.
conflicts.analysis: Text atop striking image becomes unreadable.
conflicts.resolution: Use text backing or move copy.
Use display family for short headers; practical readable body/UI face for detailed tasks.

conflicts.tension: Texture and grain decrease text legibility.
conflicts.analysis: Texture and grain decrease text legibility.
conflicts.resolution: Remove behind text or validate background under real crop.

conflicts.tension: A curated pairing has poor script coverage for localized content.
conflicts.analysis: A curated pairing has poor script coverage for localized content.
conflicts.resolution: Choose robust fallbacks and optical consistency per supported script.

conflicts.tension: Full design system is overkill for a single surface.
conflicts.analysis: Full design system is overkill for a single surface.
conflicts.resolution: Tokenize repeated decisions then evolve components where reuse warrants.

conflicts.tension: Animation may direct gaze but induce vestibular effects.
conflicts.analysis: Animation may direct gaze but induce vestibular effects.
conflicts.resolution: Prefer static hierarchy; respect reduced-motion and WCAG motion rules.

conflicts.tension: Accent and hierarchy could pressure users into unwanted choice.
conflicts.analysis: Accent and hierarchy could pressure users into unwanted choice.
conflicts.resolution: Use truthful neutral choice architecture and equal prominence when appropriate.
conflicts.override: Consent and ethics always outrank conversion.

conflicts.tension: Aesthetic preference might conflict with existing identity and expectations.
conflicts.analysis: Aesthetic preference might conflict with existing identity and expectations.
conflicts.resolution: Preserve documented brand constraints unless explicitly approved to change.
conflicts.override: Evidence of user needs outranks agent taste.
